pen=!st.treatmentDrawerOpen;save();osc(132,.2,'sawtooth',.10);treatmentDrawer()};
 if($('take-mar'))$('take-mar').onclick=()=>{st.treatmentMAR=true;newLog('Handwritten MAR: electronic administration times disagree with the original');save();treatmentDrawer()};
 if($('take-tray'))$('take-tray').onclick=()=>{st.treatmentTray=true;newLog('Medication cart tray index: breathing tray 6, adrenal tray 4, cardiac tray 2');save();treatmentDrawer()};
 })
}
function treatmentMAR(){
 if(!st.treatmentMAR||!st.treatmentTray){modal('MAR Records / Missing Chain of Custody',`<p>Retrieve both the handwritten MAR and the physical tray index from the medication cart drawer. The digital export alone is not an independent source.</p><div class="btnrow">${button('go-cart','Inspect the medication drawer','primary')}</div>`,()=>{$('go-cart').onclick=()=>treatmentDrawer()});return}
 if((st.treatmentStep||0)>=TREAT_CASES.length){treatmentCabinet();return}
 const idx=st.treatmentStep||0,c=TREAT_CASES[idx];
 const findings=c.findings.map(a=>`<tr><th>${escapeText(a[0])}</th><td>${escapeText(a[1])}</td><td>${escapeText(a[2])}</td></tr>`).join('');
 const fields=c.fields.map(([id,prompt,options,correct,why,hint],fi)=>`<div class="treat-question"><label for="treat-${id}">${escapeText(prompt)}</label><select id="treat-${id}">${balancedChoices(options,correct,idx+3,fi).map(([v,txt])=>`<option value="${escapeText(v)}">${escapeText(txt)}</option>`).join('')}</select><small>Independent clinical judgment · ${escapeText(c.tag)}</small></div>`).join('');
 modal('TREATMENT ROOM / MEDICATION INTEGRITY',`<div class="treat-file-meta"><span>FILE ${idx+1} / ${TREAT_CASES.length} · ${escapeText(c.tag)}</span><span>${escapeText(c.summary)}</span></div><div class="treat-workbench"><div class="treat-sheet"><div class="micro">RIVERMERE / RECOVERED HANDWRITTEN RECORD</div><h3>${escapeText(c.name)}</h3><p>${escapeText(c.story)}</p><table class="treat-paper-table"><tbody>${findings}</tbody></table><p class="micro">Each finding is simulated. Use printed ranges when interpreting laboratory values.</p></div><div><p class="small-note">Complete four interdependent decisions. Each is graded separately; correcting an error won't erase it from your learning report.</p><div class="treat-rows">${fields}</div><div class="btnrow" style="margin-top:14px">${button('treat-verify','Reconcile this patient file','primary')}${button('treat-hint','Mechanism clue','soft')}</div><div id="inline-message" aria-live="polite"></div></div></div>`,()=>{
 $('treat-hint').onclick=()=>{st.hints++;for(let f of c.fields){const z=st.assess['treat_'+f[0]]||{attempts:0,wrong:0,hints:0,success:false};z.hints++;st.assess['treat_'+f[0]]=z}save();message(c.fields.map(f=>f[5]).join(' · '),true)};
 $('treat-verify').onclick=()=>{
   let wrong=[];for(const [id,prompt,options,answer,why,hint] of c.fields){const chosen=$('treat-'+id).value;const ok=chosen===answer;treatScore(id,ok);if(!ok)wrong.push(why)}
   if(wrong.length){message('Some judgments conflict with the evidence. '+wrong.join(' · '));return}
   st.treatmentStep=(st.treatmentStep||0)+1;newLog('MAR reconciliation '+c.tag+': four mechanisms and priorities verified');save();osc(640,.16,'triangle',.15);
   if(st.treatmentStep===2)taviScene('treatment_control',"Student nurse, you've identified an alteration that should not exist. Close the cabinet. Immediately.",1);
   modal('RECONCILED / '+escapeText(c.tag),`<div class="treat-status"><strong>Four judgments verified.</strong><p>${escapeText(c.summary)}</p><p>The physical index identifies this file as <strong>${escapeText(c.tag)}</strong>. Keep that tray number: the cabinet requires independent evidence from all three patient records.</p></div><div class="btnrow">${button('treat-next',st.treatmentStep<TREAT_CASES.length?'Review next patient record':'Inspect the sealed cabinet','primary')}</div>`,()=>{$('treat-next').onclick=()=>{if(st.treatmentStep<TREAT_CASES.length)treatmentMAR();else treatmentCabinet()}})
 }
 })
}
